title: Penetration Tester | Telecom
summary: Penetration Tester and fourth-year Telecommunications student at Transilvania University of Brașov, specializing in offensive security, web and API penetration testing. Hands-on experience conducting client security assessments at Arvato Systems Romania and contributing to telecommunications R&D at Mitel Networks Romania, focusing on the OpenScape 4000 platform, system configuration, tooling, and virtualization. Active member of the Google.org Cybersecurity Seminars initiative, delivered in collaboration with Virtual Routes, and the CyberBrașov and InvataCyber.ro cybersecurity communities.

points: Perform web application and API penetration tests, from scoping to reporting and remediation advice.
Research AI frameworks to assist penetration testing workflows.
Expand offensive-security methodology and tooling on real client engagements.
Develop internal Python and JavaScript tooling for the OpenScape 4000 telecom platform (Assistant Manager team).
Work with Hyper-V, Linux and C components across telecom system configurations.
Active member of the local cybersecurity community: meetups and workshops.
OpenScape 4000 telecom systems: system configuration, virtualisation and C-level work.
First hands-on exposure to carrier-grade telephony platforms and their testing practices.
Operated CNC machine tools at the Cristian (Brasov) production site.
Worked to engineering drawings and quality requirements within a manufacturing team.

achievements.title: Google.org Cybersecurity Seminars: vulnerability assessment for Regional Brasov Hospital

Conducted a vulnerability assessment for the Regional Brasov Hospital.
